Package index

Mapping

Map SDTM domains into CTAS input frames.

Input_Missing()
Map a findings domain to a missingness-ratio CTAS input
Input_Numeric()
Map a numeric findings domain to CTAS input
Input_OneHot()
Map a categorical findings domain to CTAS input via one-hot encoding
Input_Range()
Map a numeric findings domain with reference ranges to CTAS input
Input_Subjects()
Map a subject-level domain to the CTAS subjects frame
Combine_CTAS_Input()
Combine domain inputs into the five CTAS input frames

Preparation

Make values comparable across parameters.

Prepare_Categorical()
One-hot encode a categorical variable
Prepare_MissingRatio()
Running ratio of missing values over time
Prepare_Normalize()
Normalize values by reference range
Prepare_TimepointRank()
Recalculate timepoint rank as a positional integer

Analysis

Run CTAS and bridge into the gsm analysis contract.

Analyze_CTAS()
Run the CTAS engine over a combined study input
Summarize_CTAS()
Aggregate CTAS site scores into the gsm Analysis_Analyzed contract
Flag_CTAS()
Flag aggregated CTAS scores
